quotes.text: An error will be thrown if the folder already exists.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entries 1499 and 1502 return an existing folder object for repeated insertion, including canonically equivalent names. Current numeric-ID insertRoot/insertFolder instead fail on an existing parent/name pair, and current tests assert that failure. Existing callers must perform lookup before a conditional insert when they intend reuse. This is a later accepted contract comparison, not independent coverage of all intervening commits. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Separate the historical idempotent insert from the current duplicate error
